name: Trinity The
overview: Scripture reveals the Trinity as the eternal and omnipotent God who created the heavens and the earth, as seen in Genesis 1:1 and affirmed by the Almighty's self-identification in Genesis 17:1. The Spirit's active role in creation and sustaining life is evident in Job 26:13 and Job 33:4, while Psalms 139:7 highlights His omnipresence. Together, these verses demonstrate the distinct persons of the Godhead working in unity, emphasizing the divine nature and authority foundational to the doctrine of the Trinity.
